pending.docs/design/memory-inplace-edit.md: owner-approved design in PR #3677; layout implementation owned by PR #3666

batches.title: What reaches ian: needs-you, questions, daily report, push
batches.scope: The attention surfaces of the phase 1 graduation criteria: the needs-you tray, question cards and their lifecycle, the 08:00 report and retro proposals, and phone push. Research Ikaga, Duet, Codex CLI and t3code first; design the tray and card states and the delivery and dedupe rules.

batches.title: Thread control and the merge decision
batches.scope: What a user can do to a running thread and how the gate verdict shows: steer, queue, stop, stop-and-done, plan approval with auto-approve, review rejection, and the merge controls with the gate verdict. Research Amp, Claude Code and t3code; design the state machine and the panels.

batches.title: Execution isolation: orbs, the agent's computer, own-key sandboxes
batches.scope: The per-task orb differentiator and the execution targets of D101: how a user sees and chooses where a thread runs, the agent's own computer and its screen, and E2B or Daytona with the user's key. Land the coordinator-computer note, then write the backend design and the machine-page and screen designs.

batches.title: Remote access and device and machine auth
batches.scope: Reaching cairn from the owner's other devices and adding machines: the tsnet route list and pairing page, seamless login from tailnet devices, and the browser machine-authorize flow. Design the pages and the enroll and pairing failure modes.

batches.title: Install to first PR: desktop app, first run, mobile web
batches.scope: The phase 2 graduation path: a stranger installs the desktop app and gets a merged PR in 10 minutes, then uses it from a phone browser. Research the desktop shells and mobile web, and design the app packaging, the first-run checklist backend and the mobile layout.

batches.title: Recurring and finding work: schedules, search and activity, sidebar
batches.scope: Scheduled tasks, the search syntax with the activity view, and the sidebar with unread marks. Research Amp, Claude Code scheduled tasks and t3code, and design the due-event model, the search index and the unread state.

batches.title: Composer and attachments
batches.scope: Everything typed or attached before a message is sent: mentions, slash commands, named prompts, drafts that survive a restart and attachments. Research claude.ai, Amp and t3code; design the draft and attachment model.

batches.title: Execution settings: skills, MCP, harness profile, quota wait
batches.scope: Settings that change how harnesses run on each machine: skills, MCP servers, the opt-in harness profile of spec 30, and quota waits when a subscription runs out. Research t3code and Amp settings and write the missing designs.

batches.title: Access settings: secrets, API keys, account and team
batches.scope: Who can do what and with which credentials: the secrets page, API keys with grants, account and team settings with PR attribution. Design the pages and the key and grant model.

batches.title: Peripheral surfaces
batches.scope: Small surfaces that work today without research or design: the Coordinator MCP face for external harnesses, built-in git hosting, server backup and deploy banners, and thread tags. Each needs a short note and a design, or a decision to retire it.

batches.title: Phase 3: iOS app
batches.scope: Work for after phase 2 graduates: the native iOS app of D22. Research and design only when phase 2 is close.
